pages.title: Exotic Crystal Singularity
pages.text: Exotic matter crystals compressed into one point. Exotic matter has negative energy density, and the singularity seems to push space away from itself slightly. It is faintly repellent to the touch. Dropped, it falls slowly, as though the floor were pushing back.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Exotic matter holds wormholes open. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that pushes everything else away.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
